title: Rate-2/3 Girth-8 (3,18)-Regular Quantum LDPC Codes from Two-Branch Finite-Field Bases and CPM Lifts
summary: We construct a rate-$2/3$ quantum low-density parity-check (LDPC) code from a $(3,18)$-regular two-branch finite-field base and a circulant-permutation-matrix (CPM) lift of degree $P=101$. The resulting code is a Calderbank--Shor--Steane (CSS) code with parameters $[[34542,23032,18]]$. Its distance is established by a computer-assisted proof: an explicit nontrivial logical operator gives the upper bound, and a complete symmetry-reduced enumeration excludes every nonzero vector of weight below 18 in both parity-check kernels.
